HtmlUtil.format_line_html_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Parse HTML text, normalize code blocks, lists, and paragraphs into plain text with consistent punctuation, then decode HTML entities and format line breaks." format_line_html_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> html_text </REF>: string "Input HTML content to normalize and convert into formatted text."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "Formatted plain-text output after HTML normalization, entity decoding, and line-feed processing."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND If html_text is None or has length 0, return an empty string immediately. RESULT '']
            [COMMAND Parse html_text with BeautifulSoup using the lxml parser to create soup. RESULT soup]
            [COMMAND Find all pre and blockquote elements in soup, then for each matched tag set its string content to self.CODE_MARK. RESULT code_tag]
            [COMMAND Find all ul and ol elements in soup, then for each list container find all descendant li elements. RESULT ul_ol_group]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over each ul or ol element, for each li element get its stripped text; if the text is empty, skip that item. RESULT li_item_text]
            [COMMAND Within the nested list-item loop, if the stripped li text ends with punctuation, replace the item string with [-] followed by the original text and continue to the next li item. RESULT li_item.string]
            [COMMAND Within the nested list-item loop, if the stripped li text does not end with punctuation, replace the item string with [-] followed by the text and a trailing period. RESULT li_item.string]
            [COMMAND Find all p elements in soup, then for each paragraph get its stripped text and process only non-empty paragraphs. RESULT p_group]
            [COMMAND Within the paragraph loop, if the paragraph text already ends with punctuation, leave it unchanged and continue to the next paragraph. RESULT p_item.string]
            [COMMAND Within the paragraph loop, if the next sibling exists and its text contains self.CODE_MARK, append a colon to the paragraph text and continue to the next paragraph. RESULT next_sibling]
            [COMMAND Within the paragraph loop, if the text is non-empty and does not end with punctuation and the next sibling does not indicate code, append a period to the paragraph text. RESULT p_item.string]
            [COMMAND Extract the full text from soup and decode HTML entities with gensim.utils.decode_htmlentities to produce clean_text. RESULT clean_text]
            [COMMAND Return the result of passing clean_text to self.__format_line_feed. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
HtmlUtil.extract_code_from_html_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extract code text from HTML by parsing pre and blockquote elements, then return the non-empty texts corresponding to detected code markers." extract_code_from_html_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> html_text </REF>: str "HTML content to inspect and extract code snippets from."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list[str] "A list of extracted non-empty code texts, or an empty list when no code marker is present."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Format the input HTML text with self.format_line_html_text(html_text) and store the result in text_with_code_tag. RESULT text_with_code_tag]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.CODE_MARK is absent from text_with_code_tag; if it is absent, return an empty list immediately. RESULT []]
            [COMMAND Initialize code_index_start to 0, parse html_text with BeautifulSoup using the 'lxml' parser, collect all pre and blockquote elements into code_tag, count occurrences of self.CODE_MARK in text_with_code_tag as code_count, and initialize code_list as an empty list. RESULT code_index_start, soup, code_tag, code_count, code_list]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over code_index from code_index_start to code_index_start + code_count exclusive, get the text of code_tag[code_index] and store it in code. RESULT code]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop, if code is truthy, append it to code_list. RESULT code_list]
            [COMMAND After the loop finishes, return code_list. RESULT code_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
